newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel did not shell Lebanese port -army sources.
newsitem.headline: Israel did not shell Lebanese port -army sources.

text.p: Israel military sources said on Monday the army was not behind the shelling of Lebanon's southern port city of Sidon in which 25 civilians were wounded.

"The Israel Defence Forces (IDF) can say with full assurance it isn't IDF shelling of Sidon," one of the sources said, adding that the attack was apparently carried out by forces of the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army militia.
"It is probably a shelling by General (Antoine) Lahd's SLA to avenge the killing of the two youths whose father was a former batallion commander in the SLA."
The Israeli army said two Lebanese youths were killed and two wounded when an explosive device blew up a vehicle in the Jezzine area of south Lebanon hours before the shelling in Sidon.

The army said Hizbollah, the Iranian-backed "Party of God", carried out the attack near Jezzine. Security sources in Lebanon said some of the 25 civilians were seriously wounded in the three rounds of shelling on Sidon.
Israel and its SLA allies patrol a 15 km (nine mile)-deep border zone set up inside Lebanon with the declared aim of preventing guerrilla attacks on Israel's northern border.
